storage_note: SignalStudio defines the table fields, keys, and case rows for a separate backend AI to implement. #1001 generates asset_id once as UUIDv7; #1002 and other tables reuse that exact ID. PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or Parquet may be chosen there if the same semantics are preserved; no table write is performed by these case rows.

assets.purpose_zh: 统一登记人物、项目、代币和社交账号等对象；每个独立对象有自己的 asset_id，身份未确认时保留待确认状态。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 系统创建的内部资产 ID（UUIDv7）

columns.name: name
columns.label_zh: 当前展示名称；待确认时可暂用来源名称

columns.name: identity_status
columns.label_zh: 身份状态：pending_identity 或 confirmed

columns.name: asset_kind
columns.label_zh: 对象类别，如人物 person、项目 project、代币 coin、社交账号 social_account；未知可空

columns.name: created_at
columns.label_zh: 系统首次建档时间

assets.create_sql: CREATE TABLE assets (asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_status IN ('pending_identity', 'confirmed')), asset_kind TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
assets.purpose_en: Register people, projects, tokens and social accounts in one identity system; each distinct object has its own asset_id and may remain pending.

asset_identifiers.purpose_zh: 用来源范围或别名类别加标识值找到 #1001 的内部资产 ID；一行只保存一条对应关系，多行可以指向同一资产。

columns.name: source_namespace
columns.label_zh: 来源范围或别名类别

columns.name: external_identifier
columns.label_zh: 外部 ID 或别名值

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 已创建的 asset_id（UUIDv7）；#1002 不另生成

asset_identifiers.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_identifiers (source_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, external_identifier TEXT NOT NULL, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), PRIMARY KEY (source_namespace, external_identifier))
asset_identifiers.purpose_en: Map each source-scoped identifier or curated alias to an existing internal asset ID; multiple rows may point to one asset.

asset_relationships.purpose_zh: 保存对象之间经过审核的有向关系。正反各有独立行 ID，仅记录系统录入时间。

columns.name: row_id
columns.label_zh: 每一行关系记录的唯一 ID

columns.name: from_asset_id
columns.label_zh: 起点对象 ID

columns.name: to_asset_id
columns.label_zh: 终点对象 ID

columns.name: relationship_type
columns.label_zh: 关系类型

columns.name: evidence_ref
columns.label_zh: 关系证据

columns.name: review_id
columns.label_zh: 批准记录 ID

columns.name: created_at
columns.label_zh: 系统记录这条关系的时间；不表示关系实际开始或结束

asset_relationships.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_relationships (row_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, from_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), to_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), relationship_type TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_ref TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (from_asset_id <> to_asset_id))
asset_relationships.purpose_en: Store reviewed directed relationships between objects. Each direction has its own row ID and records only its system entry time.

asset_monitoring_rules.purpose_zh: 按资产保存经审核的规则及其版本。

columns.name: rule_id
columns.label_zh: 规则 ID

columns.name: version
columns.label_zh: 版本号

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 资产 ID

columns.name: metric_key
columns.label_zh: 指标键

columns.name: rule_json
columns.label_zh: 规则内容 JSON

columns.name: status
columns.label_zh: 规则状态

columns.name: review_id
columns.label_zh: 批准记录 ID

columns.name: effective_at
columns.label_zh: 生效时间

asset_monitoring_rules.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_monitoring_rules (rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), metric_key TEXT NOT NULL, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, version))
asset_monitoring_rules.purpose_en: Store reviewed, versioned monitoring rules for assets.

asset_score_events.purpose_zh: 汇集各评分程序已经确认的加分事实；每笔分引用详细判定记录，并使用稳定 event_key 防重。规划经待评审的评分事件 Topic 分别投影至 Redis 与 Delta/Parquet 长期流水；Redis 不是唯一账本。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 的内部资产 ID

columns.name: asset_name
columns.label_zh: 随事件传递的资产名称快照，供展示和调试；不参与主键、去重或计算，旧记录可为空

columns.name: event_key
columns.label_zh: 由资产 ID、评分维度和判定记录引用稳定生成的去重键

columns.name: score_key
columns.label_zh: 本次加分所属指标；全量热度 Demo 固定为 total_heat，新指标需另行定义

columns.name: decision_ref
columns.label_zh: 评分程序命名空间和其详细判定记录 ID；据此查询原始输入、命中原因和规则版本

columns.name: score_delta
columns.label_zh: 本次入账的分数变化量；看空证据通常给看空维度加正分，明确扣分或冲销可为负数

columns.name: created_at
columns.label_zh: 评分事件被系统接受时确定的入账时间，UTC；实时窗口和归档沿用同一时间

columns.name: decay_policy_ref
columns.label_zh: 该笔事件首次接受时确定的不可变衰减规则版本；用于校验与追溯

columns.name: half_life_minutes
columns.label_zh: 该笔事件首次接受时确定的正数半衰期分钟数；Demo 为 10080，归档与缓存沿用

asset_score_events.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_score_events (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), asset_name TEXT, event_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score_key TEXT NOT NULL, decision_ref TEXT NOT NULL, score_delta REAL NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, decay_policy_ref TEXT NOT NULL, half_life_minutes REAL NOT NULL CHECK (half_life_minutes > 0), UNIQUE (asset_id, score_key, decision_ref))
asset_score_events.purpose_en: Collect deduplicated score contributions from program-owned decision records by asset and score dimension.

asset_scores_current.purpose_zh: 保存各资产评分在 calculated_at 时刻的值；Demo 只使用 total_heat 全量热度。#3005 只读取 #6001 Redis 评分事件，按已有 asset_id 分组；新贡献成功入缓存后立即计算受影响资产，另每 60 秒刷新全部事件资产的衰减。每次在同一 UTC 时刻汇总并写入当前分；不读取 #1001，不为无事件资产新写或刷新 0 分，有事件合计为 0 仍保存，空事件集合无输出。旧历史行不自动删除。默认排名读取最近一轮保存的分数；实际回填快照与后台调度分别展示。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 的内部资产 ID

columns.name: asset_name
columns.label_zh: 随评分结果传递的资产名称快照，供展示和调试；旧记录可为空

columns.name: score_key
columns.label_zh: 评分指标唯一键；本次 Demo 固定为 total_heat（全量热度）

columns.name: score_value
columns.label_zh: 该资产在此指标上的当前分数；内部保留计算精度，仅展示保留两位小数

columns.name: calculated_at
columns.label_zh: score_value 对应的 UTC 计算时刻；读取保存值，不按查询时间再次衰减

asset_scores_current.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_scores_current (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), asset_name TEXT, score_key TEXT NOT NULL, score_value REAL NOT NULL, calculated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, score_key))
asset_scores_current.purpose_en: Materialize total_heat only for assets with score events: recompute affected assets immediately after new contributions and refresh all event assets every 60 seconds. No registry reads or zero filling for eventless assets; retain zero totals from real events. Read stored scores without query-time decay; derive ranks on read.

supabase_asset_scores.purpose_zh: 供前端查询的得分副本。#1006 某资产得分变化时，只在该资产当前位于前 100 时同步它：已有更新，缺失新增。不主动补位。出榜旧行保留，总行数可超过 100；前端先筛选 calculated_at 最近 3 分钟的记录，再排序分页最多 100。同步无等待窗口，不写排名。尚未创建实际 Supabase 表。
supabase_asset_scores.purpose_en: On an asset score change, upsert only that asset if currently top 100; never backfill passive entrants. Retain old rows; the table can exceed 100 rows. Frontend filters calculated_at to the last three minutes before sorting and pagination up to 100. No sync wait window or stored rank. Not deployed.

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 的内部资产 ID

columns.name: asset_name
columns.label_zh: 随评分结果传递的资产名称快照，供展示和调试；旧记录可为空

columns.name: score_key
columns.label_zh: 评分指标唯一键；本次 Demo 固定为 total_heat（全量热度）

columns.name: score_value
columns.label_zh: 该资产在此指标上的当前分数；内部保留计算精度，仅展示保留两位小数

columns.name: calculated_at
columns.label_zh: score_value 对应的 UTC 计算时刻；读取保存值，不按查询时间再次衰减

columns.name: source_version
columns.label_zh: 该资产和维度的来源单调版本；按键控制进度防止旧任务覆盖（待实现）

columns.name: synced_at
columns.label_zh: 本行成功同步到 Supabase 的 UTC 时间

supabase_asset_scores.create_sql: CREATE TABLE supabase_asset_scores (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL, asset_name TEXT, score_key TEXT NOT NULL, score_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, calculated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, source_version BIGINT NOT NULL, synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, score_key)); CREATE INDEX supabase_asset_scores_leaderboard ON supabase_asset_scores (score_key, score_value DESC, asset_id ASC);

asset_initial_score_sources.label_zh: 首次建档来源评分配置
asset_initial_score_sources.purpose_zh: 按发现来源配置首次建档分；#3009读取，一项资产只奖励一次。
asset_initial_score_sources.purpose_en: Configure the one-time creation award by discovery source; read by #3009.

columns.name: source_id
columns.label_zh: 稳定发现来源标识；不是资产身份命名空间

columns.name: source_name
columns.label_zh: 来源展示名称

columns.name: initial_score
columns.label_zh: 首次建档贡献，有限正数

columns.name: rule_version
columns.label_zh: 不可变衰减规则引用；本版保留asset_initial_score/v1

columns.name: half_life_minutes
columns.label_zh: 半衰期分钟数，与引用的规则版本一致

asset_initial_score_sources.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_initial_score_sources (source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_name TEXT NOT NULL, initial_score REAL NOT NULL CHECK(initial_score > 0), rule_version TEXT NOT NULL, half_life_minutes REAL NOT NULL CHECK(half_life_minutes > 0))

weight_topics.purpose_zh: 统一话题身份；DeFi、游戏不因名称写法不同重复建档。
weight_topics.purpose_en: Stable topic identities shared by weight rules and evaluations.

columns.name: topic_id
columns.label_zh: 稳定话题 ID

columns.name: name
columns.label_zh: 话题名称

columns.name: definition
columns.label_zh: 话题边界说明

columns.name: status
columns.label_zh: active / retired

weight_topics.create_sql: CREATE TABLE weight_topics (topic_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, definition TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','retired')))

weight_evaluations.purpose_zh: 保存一次判断的评价依据；结果未知时保留待评价，不推定正确或错误。
weight_evaluations.purpose_en: Retain evidence for evaluating a judgment; unknown outcomes stay pending.

columns.name: evaluation_id
columns.label_zh: 独立评价记录 ID

columns.name: source_ref
columns.label_zh: 原始消息/判断的稳定引用

columns.name: subject_asset_id
columns.label_zh: 被评价对象→assets.asset_id

columns.name: topic_id
columns.label_zh: 评价话题→weight_topics.topic_id

columns.name: evaluation_key
columns.label_zh: 评价目标；影响力与判断质量必须分开

columns.name: window_start
columns.label_zh: 观察窗口开始时间

columns.name: window_end
columns.label_zh: 观察窗口结束时间

columns.name: status
columns.label_zh: pending / evaluated / inconclusive

columns.name: result
columns.label_zh: 评价值；含义与方法尚未确定

columns.name: evidence_ref
columns.label_zh: 结果证据引用

columns.name: method_version
columns.label_zh: 评价方法版本；尚未确定

columns.name: evaluated_at
columns.label_zh: 实际完成评价时间

weight_evaluations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE weight_evaluations (evaluation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, source_ref TEXT NOT NULL, subject_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), topic_id TEXT REFERENCES weight_topics(topic_id), evaluation_key TEXT NOT NULL, window_start TEXT NOT NULL, window_end TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(window_end>window_start), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','evaluated','inconclusive')), result REAL, evidence_ref TEXT, method_version TEXT, evaluated_at TEXT, CHECK ((status='pending' AND result IS NULL AND evaluated_at IS NULL) OR (status='evaluated' AND result IS NOT NULL AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND method_version IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at>=window_end) OR (status='inconclusive' AND result IS NULL AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at>=window_end)))

weight_rule_versions.purpose_zh: 保留规则范围和系数的不可变版本；同一个账号不因调权重生成新身份。
weight_rule_versions.purpose_en: Immutable rule scope and coefficient versions; changing weights does not create a new account identity.

columns.name: version_id
columns.label_zh: 独立版本 ID

columns.name: rule_id
columns.label_zh: 稳定规则 ID；不同于被加权对象 ID

columns.name: purpose_key
columns.label_zh: 评分用途，如 project_heat

columns.name: weight_layer
columns.label_zh: 权重层：signal / source / subject

columns.name: signal_type
columns.label_zh: 信号类型；不是来源平台

columns.name: source_id
columns.label_zh: 来源 ID；NULL 表示此层不限来源

columns.name: subject_asset_id
columns.label_zh: 对象外键→assets.asset_id；账号权重必须引用账号 UUID

columns.name: topic_id
columns.label_zh: 话题外键；NULL 表示默认话题范围

columns.name: coefficient
columns.label_zh: 此版本系数；有限且非负

columns.name: version_number
columns.label_zh: 同一规则内递增版本号

columns.name: effective_at
columns.label_zh: UTC 生效时间

columns.name: change_reason
columns.label_zh: 变更原因

columns.name: evaluation_refs_json
columns.label_zh: 评价记录 ID 数组；手工设置可为空

columns.name: method_version
columns.label_zh: 人工/算法更新方法版本

weight_rule_versions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE weight_rule_versions (version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, purpose_key TEXT NOT NULL, weight_layer TEXT NOT NULL, signal_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT, subject_asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(asset_id), topic_id TEXT REFERENCES weight_topics(topic_id), coefficient REAL NOT NULL CHECK(coefficient>=0 AND coefficient<=1e308), version_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version_number>0), effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, change_reason TEXT NOT NULL, evaluation_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL, method_version TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(rule_id,version_number), UNIQUE(version_id,rule_id,coefficient,effective_at), CHECK ((weight_layer='signal' AND source_id IS NULL AND subject_asset_id IS NULL AND topic_id IS NULL) OR (weight_layer='source' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_asset_id IS NULL AND topic_id IS NULL) OR (weight_layer='subject' AND subject_asset_id IS NOT NULL)))

weight_rules_current.purpose_zh: 按用途与范围保存当前权重；账号规则直接引用 #1001 的账号 UUID，不使用所属项目替代。
weight_rules_current.purpose_en: Current rules by purpose and scope; account weights directly reference the account asset UUID, not its project.

columns.name: rule_id
columns.label_zh: 稳定规则 ID

columns.name: current_version_id
columns.label_zh: 引用同一 rule_id 的准确版本

columns.name: purpose_key
columns.label_zh: 评分用途，如 project_heat

columns.name: weight_layer
columns.label_zh: 权重层：signal / source / subject

columns.name: signal_type
columns.label_zh: 信号类型；不是来源平台

columns.name: source_id
columns.label_zh: 来源 ID；NULL 表示此层不限来源

columns.name: subject_asset_id
columns.label_zh: 对象外键→assets.asset_id；账号权重必须引用账号 UUID

columns.name: topic_id
columns.label_zh: 话题外键；NULL 表示默认话题范围

columns.name: coefficient
columns.label_zh: 当前系数；须与引用版本完全一致

columns.name: effective_at
columns.label_zh: 当前版本生效时间

weight_rules_current.create_sql: CREATE TABLE weight_rules_current (rule_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, current_version_id TEXT NOT NULL, purpose_key TEXT NOT NULL, weight_layer TEXT NOT NULL, signal_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT, subject_asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(asset_id), topic_id TEXT REFERENCES weight_topics(topic_id), coefficient REAL NOT NULL CHECK(coefficient>=0 AND coefficient<=1e308), effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(current_version_id,rule_id,coefficient,effective_at) REFERENCES weight_rule_versions(version_id,rule_id,coefficient,effective_at), CHECK ((weight_layer='signal' AND source_id IS NULL AND subject_asset_id IS NULL AND topic_id IS NULL) OR (weight_layer='source' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_asset_id IS NULL AND topic_id IS NULL) OR (weight_layer='subject' AND subject_asset_id IS NOT NULL)))
